svg.title: From paid visits to settled calls
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-02-nested-cohort-settlement-funnel; chart type: funnel; title: From paid visits to settled calls; subtitle: A single annual cohort produces the Base-Case $850,000 gross settlement model.; chapter number: 6; epistemic tag: illustrative_model; assumptions note: All five stages belong to the same illustrative annual cohort. Each later stage is a subset of the prior stage, with one counted call per qualifying visit. The 3,400 final calls average $250 in gross billable settlements; these rates are model inputs, not measured campaign results.; caption: 100,000 visits × 10% × 50% × 80% × 85% = 3,400 settled calls. Gross settlements equal $850,000; the 55% retained share equals $467,500 before remaining modeled costs.; stages: label: Tracked paid visits; value: 100,000 visits enter the same annual cohort; numeric value: 100000.0; detail: Count attributed landing-page visits after traffic-quality filtering. Use a stable campaign identifier and defined attribution window; do not mix impressions or repeat telephone attempts into this visit count.; label: Visits initiating calls; value: 10,000 call starts; 10% of tracked visits; numeric value: 10000.0; detail: Count the first tracked call initiation associated with each converting visit. A telephone-link click without an actual call start does not enter this stage.; label: Unique eligible inquiries; value: 5,000 inquiries; 50% of call starts; numeric value: 5000.0; detail: Remove duplicates, wrong-service inquiries, out-of-area callers, and inquiries lacking required routing permission. Preserve exclusion reasons so source quality can be reconciled with publisher invoices.; label: Buyer-qualified connections; value: 4,000 connections; 80% of eligible inquiries; numeric value: 4000.0; detail: Require buyer connection, contracted intent, and the specified 90–120 second buffer. An AI transcript label supports review but does not override buyer acceptance terms or the actual call clock.; label: Settled billable calls; value: 3,400 calls; 85% of qualified connections; numeric value: 3400.0; detail: Exclude 600 rejected or reversed connections before applying the $250 settlement average. The resulting $850,000 is exchange settlement volume, not the value of policies, repairs, legal matters, or client purchases.

text.title: From paid visits to settled calls
text.tspan: From paid visits to settled calls

rect.title: label: Tracked paid visits; value: 100,000 visits enter the same annual cohort; numeric value: 100000.0; detail: Count attributed landing-page visits after traffic-quality filtering. Use a stable campaign identifier and defined attribution window; do not mix impressions or repeat telephone attempts into this visit count.

label: Visits initiating calls; value: 10,000 call starts; 10% of tracked visits; numeric value: 10000.0; detail: Count the first tracked call initiation associated with each converting visit. A telephone-link click without an actual call start does not enter this stage.

label: Unique eligible inquiries; value: 5,000 inquiries; 50% of call starts; numeric value: 5000.0; detail: Remove duplicates, wrong-service inquiries, out-of-area callers, and inquiries lacking required routing permission. Preserve exclusion reasons so source quality can be reconciled with publisher invoices.

label: Buyer-qualified connections; value: 4,000 connections; 80% of eligible inquiries; numeric value: 4000.0; detail: Require buyer connection, contracted intent, and the specified 90–120 second buffer. An AI transcript label supports review but does not override buyer acceptance terms or the actual call clock.

label: Settled billable calls; value: 3,400 calls; 85% of qualified connections; numeric value: 3400.0; detail: Exclude 600 rejected or reversed connections before applying the $250 settlement average. The resulting $850,000 is exchange settlement volume, not the value of policies, repairs, legal matters, or client purchases.

text.title: Assumptions: All five stages belong to the same illustrative annual cohort. Each later stage is a subset of the prior stage, with one counted call per qualifying visit. The 3,400 final calls average $250 in gross billable settlements; these rates are model inputs, not measured campaign results.
